summary: Static review found no blocking defects. Required checks, the historical failing run, and generation without drift could not be independently verified because execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC1: Failing tests precede implementation and the failing run is recorded.
checks.evidence: Git snapshots show test_schema_model.py was added before the records. scripts/ralph/batches/t0b-contracts/prd.json:234 contains the failing-run note, but no independently observed execution establishes that run.

checks.criterion: AC2: ModelRecord fields, GateStatus, required keys, unknown-field rejection and nullable ONNX hash.
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/schema.py:1728 defines the required fields without mock or defaults and reuses GateStatus and Sha256. pipeline/tests/test_schema_model.py:540, :555, :624 and :649 contain substantive parsing, missing-field, hash round-trip and EXPERIMENTAL rejection assertions.

checks.criterion: AC3: MetricRecord fields, eight test IDs, Predicted label, availability/count rules and interval handling.
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/schema.py:1499 and :1541 define the enums, fields and validators. The validator preserves nulls and checks interval endpoint order without bounding the estimate. pipeline/tests/test_schema_model.py:669, :679, :707, :722, :730 and :784 exercise the required behaviors.

checks.criterion: AC4: G5ConditionRecord fields, threshold nullability, reasons, components and pass evidence.
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/schema.py:1615 defines the condition bounds and :1619 defines the fields and guards. pipeline/tests/test_schema_model.py:810, :851, :869, :889 and :906 exercise the required cases. Pass-without-evidence rejection is Python-only; pipeline/tests/test_json_schema.py:1874 explicitly covers that limitation.

checks.criterion: AC5: MetricsFile, G5 summary, ablations and run-record fields.
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/schema.py:1657, :1666, :1700 and :1714 define the records. Unavailable ablations require a reason and empty metrics. pipeline/tests/test_schema_model.py:1045 and :1063 exercise mock/null-run parsing and unavailable-ablation rejection.

checks.criterion: AC6: EmbeddingRecord and EmbeddingsIndex fields, exact float16 values and row count.
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/schema.py:1751 uses struct packing and unpacking to check exact float16 representation; :1767 fixes embedding length at 256; :1811 checks n_rows against rows. pipeline/tests/test_schema_model.py:927, :932, :939 and :998 cover the boundaries. The row-count engineering choice is recorded at scripts/ralph/batches/t0b-contracts/prd.json:234.

checks.criterion: AC7: All 13 named test scenarios were written before implementation.
checks.evidence: The a5a6caa tree contains the named scenarios now at pipeline/tests/test_schema_model.py:540 through :1045, before the implementation addition. The subsequent test-file diff contains only the override-helper correction and strengthened record round-trip comparison.

checks.criterion: AC8: Contract pin, valid/invalid shared cases, three-validator execution and regeneration without drift.
checks.evidence: The four contracts are pinned at pipeline/tests/test_json_schema.py:68 and registered at schema.py:1867. Shared cases start at fixtures/schema-cases/cases.json:24183; Python and Zod runners exercise their authored verdicts. Execution and regeneration were prohibited, so validator results and drift remain unverified.

checks.criterion: Story-wide record base, required nullable fields, registration and unchanged schema version.
checks.evidence: All new record classes inherit Record and declare fields without defaults. Record retains strict, frozen, extra-forbidden and rust-regex configuration. SCHEMA_VERSION remains 1.0.0. Required-field and frozen-record assertions appear at pipeline/tests/test_schema_model.py:475 and :494.
